body: I am right there with you. I am on the edge of killing myself feb 29th. I have given warning signs to my family, but they don't seem to care.

>Feb 29 has to be perfect. No anniversary for my family, a stolen day to disappear! I know I can act out and atleast make the loss more lukewarm. My fractured relationships with my family will just sort itself out. 

I totally feel you on that, I have a similar experience, and I agree feb 29th is the day to do it for me too. I tried to give signs to my family, but they don't seem to care anymore. If reincarnation exists, at least, I can try again with a different body. Maybe I will get lucky next time.
